messages.subject: Generalized Linear Mixed Models (GLMMs) in R course - online, 21-24 September
parts:
Dear lavaan community,

We are pleased to invite you to the 4th edition of the Generalized Linear Mixed Models (GLMMs) in R course, held online from September 21 to 24.


Find full details and registration here:
https://www.physalia-courses.org/courses-work/glmms-in-r

This course is ideal for graduate students and researchers familiar with generalized linear models who want to expand their skills to analyze complex grouped and correlated data using lme4 and glmmTMB. The course also covers model diagnostics and assumption checking using DHARMa.

While the basics of linear models, generalized linear models, and ANOVA will be reviewed, participants without a solid foundation in these topics may benefit more from our related course, “Generalized Linear Models as a Unified Framework for Data Analysis in R.:  https://www.physalia-courses.org/courses-workshops/glm-in-r-1/ 


We look forward to your participation!

Best regards,


Carlo
